name: Should I choose LED, fluorescent, or incandescent lighting for my kitchen upgrade?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose LED, fluorescent, or incandescent lighting for my kitchen upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: For kitchen lighting upgrades today, LED (Light Emitting Diode) is the recommended choice. Incandescent bulbs are largely phased out due to their inefficiency and short lifespan. Fluorescent lighting, while more efficient than incandescent, often has a less desirable color rendition and can be slow to start or flicker. LEDs offer superior energy efficiency, a significantly longer lifespan (often tens of thousands of hours), instant-on functionality, and a wide range of color temperatures and dimming options, providing both functional and aesthetic benefits for your kitchen.
acceptedAnswer.description: LED lighting is recommended for kitchen upgrades due to its superior energy efficiency, longer lifespan, and versatile options compared to fluorescent or incandescent bulbs.
